changeSet.comment: Practice scripts no longer call decision, embedding or reranking models. Deletes the bindings of those purposes, the shared connections of those protocols with their models; prices and workspace grants go with their models. Past ledger rows stay.

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup and start the previous release. The deleted bindings, connections and models held no person data.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'review_model_digest'

changeSet.comment: A frozen review method now holds one slot, review. Every stored method keeps only that slot, without the direct-model limits in its options, and gets the digest of what remains, so earlier and later reviews compare alike.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_practice rp SET method = jsonb_build_object('epoch', rp.method -> 'epoch', 'modelDigest', review_model_digest(n.models), 'models', n.models) FROM ( SELECT r.review_id, r.practice_id, COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.value -> 'model') = 'object' THEN jsonb_set(s.value, '{model,options}', COALESCE(s.value #> '{model,options}', '{}'::jsonb) - 'directModelTokensPerAttempt' - 'directModelSearchUnitsPerAttempt') ELSE s.value END) FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.method -> 'models') s WHERE s.value ->> 'slot' = 'review'), '[]'::jsonb) AS models FROM review_practice r WHERE r.method IS NOT NULL ) n WHERE rp.review_id = n.review_id AND rp.practice_id = n.practice_id;

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup and start the previous release. The removed slots and options cannot be rebuilt.
